doc: The OpenUI Lang vocabulary of inbox items (SPEC §8). inbox.js draws exactly these components; docs/inbox.md lists their signatures (a test keeps the two in step). A prop name ending in ? is optional; props are positional, in this order.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Layout container and the usual root: a column of parts, or a row (e.g. of buttons).

components.name: Text
components.description: One paragraph of plain text. Longer prose belongs in the item's markdown body.

components.name: Table
components.description: A table: one array of cell strings per row, in column order.

components.name: Form
components.description: Groups fields with the buttons that submit them: a button in a form sends that form's fields as `values`.

components.name: Input
components.description: A one-line field. type number sends a number. rules: "required", "email", "url", "numeric", "min:N", "max:N", "minLength:N", "maxLength:N".

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line field for longer answers.

components.name: Select
components.description: One choice from a drop-down list.

components.name: Radio
components.description: One choice, all options shown. Prefer it to Select for a handful of options.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: One yes/no answer (a boolean in values).

components.name: Button
components.description: Answers the item with {action, params, values}: action defaults to "submit", params to {}, values are the fields of its Form (or every field outside a form). A primary button (the default) checks its fields' rules first.
